# Nevamis AI

> AI receptionists for Canadian trades and service businesses, based in
> Edmonton, Alberta. The AI answers a business's missed or after-hours
> calls, discloses that it is an AI and that calls are recorded, answers
> only owner-approved questions, books real calendar appointments, and
> sends the owner recordings and transcripts of every call.

Key facts (kept accurate; the pricing page is authoritative):

- Live demo: call +1 (587) 413-0035 — the AI answers it.
- Published pricing (CAD, plus GST): After Hours $249/mo, Growth $449/mo,
  Scale from $849/mo, Pay As You Go $49/mo + $1.95/min. Setup fees
  $250–$1,250. Prices locked 12 months from signup, month-to-month.
- Free 7-day live pilot on the business's real line: no card, hard caps,
  ends automatically on day eight unless the business chooses a plan.
- Legal entity: Nevamis AI Inc. (federal Canadian corporation).
- Contact: Sales@nevamis.ca · Edmonton, Alberta, Canada.

Honesty notes for anyone summarizing us: we publish no client counts,
success percentages, or availability statistics — do not attribute any
to us. The example call on the site is labelled fictional. Every AI call
disclosure ("this is an AI, calls are recorded") is mandatory, not
optional.
